About US

Since 1997, Eddie Pearson Roofing has proudly served Mississippi with expert residential and commercial roofing services. With over 35 years of experience, we’re committed to delivering top-quality craftsmanship and customer service that’s second to none.

Whether you need a new roof, repairs, or a full replacement, we offer reliable solutions tailored to your needs. We are among the few GAF Master Elite® Certified installers in Mississippi—a distinction earned by less than 3% of roofing companies nationwide. This allows us to offer GAF’s Golden Pledge® Warranty, which covers both manufacturer defects and our workmanship. It’s even transferable if you sell your home.

In addition to GAF’s warranty, we provide a 2-year contractor’s warranty on all work completed by our team, giving you added peace of mind.

At Eddie Pearson Roofing, we don’t just build roofs—we build trust. Let us help protect your home or business with lasting quality.
